<div class="name-title">Peyman Kor</div>

<div class="headline">AI & Decision Analytics | GenAI Researcher & Educator | Data Scientist </div>

<div class="summary-section">
<h2>Summary</h2>

I am Peyman Kor - a Data Scientist and Machine Learning/AI Researcher.

Originally from Iran, I'm now based in Norway, completing my Ph.D. in Reinforcement Learning. 


<!--**Currently** I am exploring three main areas:

<div class="research-areas">
1. Agentic AI and LLM workflow for automation and productivity.
2. Reinforcement Learning for improving reasoning in LLMs.
3. Decision-quality and science of better decision making.
</div>
-->

My doctoral work test focuses on Reinforcement Learning, investigating both classical approaches [like Q-learning](https://www.mdpi.com/1999-4893/17/9/400){target="_blank"} and innovative applications such as RL for LLMs [Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback](https://github.com/Peymankor/RLHF/blob/main/main.pdf){target="_blank"}. 

Prior to my PhD, as a Data Scientist, I was part of a successful industry collaboration project focused on optimizing, resulting in developing an innovative [Bayesian Optimization](https://onepetro.org/SJ/article-abstract/29/02/620/535724/Reservoir-Production-Management-With-Bayesian?redirectedFrom=fulltext){target="_blank"} workflow.

Previously, I studied at the Technical University of Denmark and worked on diverse computational projects. In addition, I hold an M.Sc in Engineering from the University of Stavanger, specializing [developing practical ML solutions](https://bookdown.org/kor_peyman/masterthesisuis/){target="_blank"} for real-world problems.

I'm actively engaged on [GitHub](https://github.com/peymankor){target="_blank"} and regularly share findings through my [blog](/blog){target="_blank"}.
